provider_receipt.summary: Independent read-only review completed with sufficient receipt-backed source evidence. The prior verification receipt covers `git status --short --branch` with exit code 0 and the declared clean-tree check passed. Existing tests do not cover these cases. No files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
